sampling_rule: For each category, enumerate complete model roots under dataset_root/data; let rel be the path relative to dataset_root/data (category/source/model_id), compute SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of seed + "/" + rel (no trailing newline), sort ascending by hash, and select the first min(5, n_available) roots without replacement. Categories with fewer than 5 roots contribute all available roots.
